_comment: demi_demi's SOUND v3 — TRANCE (full recompose; Switch Angel bank spent). D minor, 138. One five-note cell is the whole song: the acid lead runs it in 16ths, the bass is the same cell cloned two octaves down (rolling, never naked). Acid saw born dull, filter opens = energy; gated saw chords shimmer; sidechain faked with gain patterns (duck*/supersaw await a pin bump). Crate samples are the voice; lpenv is runtime-proven as of v2. Overrides cookbook default; riser falls back.
acid: note("[d3 f3 d3 a3 g3 d3 f3 c3]*2").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.range(300,2200).slow(16)).lpenv(3).lpdecay(0.12).gain(0.3)

bass: note("[d1 f1 d1 a1 g1 d1 f1 c1]*2").s("sawtooth").lpf(550).lpq(5).gain(0.72)
